content.title: The Secret Lives Of Mormon Wives: Jessi Ngatikaura's Age, Job, Instagram, & More
content.text: As The Secret Lives Of Mormon Wives approaches its second season, Jessi Ngatikaura is poised to make her return as one of the members of the Mormon influencer group, MomTok. The group made a name for itself by sharing content about motherhood, speaking to those in search of an identity outside their kids and families. Its success led to financial freedom with both brand partnerships and the show, but it also brought along plenty of drama. Founding member Taylor Frankie Paul faced a divorce, an arrest, and a swinging scandal, leading to turmoil within the group. Jessi's Age She Will Be 32 In Season 2 Jessi was 31 in The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives season 1, which made her the oldest member of MomTok. Although the pilot episode was filmed in February 2023, the show went on a hiatus due to Taylor’s arrest. Filming resumed in late 2023. Jessi’s husband Jordan shared a birthday tribute to his wife on May 25, 2024, for what was presumably her 32nd birthday. The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives season 2 began filming in late 2024, which means Jessi will be 32 years old for the duration of the season. She will turn 33 in May 2025. Jessi's Job She’s A Hairstylist While all the members of MomTok make a living as influencers, Jessi also has a successful career as a hairdresser. She owns a salon, JZ Styles, as well as a line of hair extensions. Jessi also runs a hair school called JZ Academy. Related 25 Best Reality TV Shows Right Now Reality TV is more popular than ever. With so many to choose from, here are some of the best reality TV shows to stream or watch right now. Jessi's Instagram Jessi has an impressive social media fanbase, with 563K followers on her Instagram, @_justjessiiii. Just as on The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives, Jessi doesn’t hold back when it comes to her posts. She shares everything from her daily routines and beauty tips to posts about her family and friends, along with updates about her business and the show. Jessi’s online presence isn’t limited to her account. She also has a following on her business accounts, with nearly 150K followers on her extension and salon page @jzstyles.co. Her hair school account, @jzacademy, showcases some of the school’s best looks as well as celebrates its students. She's A Married Mother Of Three Jessi is married to Jordan Ngatikaura. According to People, Jessi and Jordan got married in 2020. They share three children: son Jagger, and daughters Peyton and Jovi. Like Jessi, Jordan is an entrepreneur. He owns a solar panel company and also displays his cooking skills on an Instagram page, Naughty Kitchen. Related There’s Still Time To Watch This Scandalous 8-Episode Reality TV Show Before Season 2 Premieres In May The Secret Lives Of Mormon Wives caught on quickly & became massive, but if you missed the boat on the first season, you still have time to catch up. Jessi was a pivotal member of The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives season 1, and she will be back in full force in season 2. After a series of scandals nearly broke the group apart in season 1, it will be interesting to see how the women come back together and restore harmony within MomTok. As long as Jessi’s involved, there’s no question she will seek the truth whenever necessary, even if it ruffles some feathers along the way.
